notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.5
notes.content:
[b]Fixed bug with Twirt in Tavern:[/b]
For everybody who already found this bug - quest will become completed and reward gained automatically. For new game quest will work as it have to. 

[b]GUI Scale with 4K support:[/b]
Now users with screen resolution 1920x1080 and higher can find special parameter "GUI Scale" in Settings->Video. Available scale values depends on your resolution and can be one of x1, x1.2, x1.5, x2, x2.4. Warning! GUI created for x1 scale, so dependent on you monitor size, resolution and selected scale, GUI can loose it's sharpness end become tiny blurry.

Thank you for the feedback and stay tuned! ːwnk_arthurː

notes.content:
Ho-Ho-Ho, dear friends! We prepared for you two large Christmas presents.

notes.title: Hooray! Patch 1.1.2 arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/95b6c38bb2de43d21990e91fa830cdfcfde60d4b.png[/img]
Dear gamers! We are thankful for your support and feedback. As promised, we are continue to work on the game even after full release, and current update is the best prove of this. ːsteamhappyː

[b]New shop - main development of this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shop interface fully redesigned to be more user-friendly.
[*] Added possibility to change team member, on whose behalf you would look through the shop, right in the shop window.
[*] Added tabs to filter shop and inventory items.
[*] Fixed ingredients cost, Исправлена стоимость некоторых ингредиентов, that earlier made unfavourable and useless craft system.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added possibility to change difficulty level right in the game from settings menu (tab "Others").
[*] Fixed loot spawning in unreachable points.
[*] Added automatic healing for all team members after win in combat.
[*] Team members and enemies no more collect theirs Action Points while under Stun, Freeze or Chain effects.
[/list]

[b]Fixed characters Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed life healing for Guinevere if somewho from your team members was attacked and Guinevere has the "Word of Life" skill.
[*] Fixed Action Points recovery by Kerdik after use the "Ruin" skill.
[*] Fixed Action Points recovery by Idril after use the "Rapid Fire" skill.
[/list]

[b]Localization fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Names for some Skills and Bufs/DeBuffs.
[*] Added information about chance to Stun when using Guinevere's "Lightning Strike" skill.
[*] Fixed description for Strength stat. "Increase physical armor" changed to "Increase Initiative".
[*] Other minor fixed for localization issues.
[/list]

In the next update we will update Pathfinding and navigation system, characters AI, tiny more improve game balance and a little more, so you can take even more enjoy from Willy-Nilly Knight game. ːwnk_arthurː

We must also pay special tribute to our most active gamers:
[list]
[*] =AJSA= Big Mad Wolf
[*] lividman
[*] [255]ThePhiphi
[*] DaurShlaG
[*] Indream
[*] Zlish
[*] Dasparado
[*] Dogtown1
[*] Graynef
[*] [MCDFB] CallmeNezo (DK)
[*] Ratibor92
[/list]
Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions, which help us to make Willy-Nilly Knight better! Sorry if we lost somebody in this list, but we love oll of you! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: We need your help!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/08ecdca771b02a611870516f52f3a65574694181.png[/img]
Dear Gamers!

As you know, our game developed by small independent team of two people. We don't have large team or huge budget. We make Willy-Nilly Knight fully on our own money. That's why we are very dependent on the value of sales of the game, which are dependent on game reviews.

We know that our game isn't perfect, We know about it's cons and we have some work to do. And We continue to work on it day by day. We've proven it while was in Early Access and prove it now, trying to answer on your questions as promptly as We can. Furthermore now we work on large and important update based on your feedback, this update will come in couple of days.

Right now the most part of reviews is negative, because of satisfied gamers just play the game and go away, but disgruntled gamers are frustrated and they want to share their emotions to each other. Furthermore a lot of reviews based on comparing our game with AAA games, such as Divinity OS, which have millions dollars development budget, and this is not objectively describe  our game as good or bad. One more time - We know our game not perfect, but it's not as bad as it looks like based on reviews.

We don't ask you to give false feedback but if you like our game We are very ask you to give us five minutes of your time and honest positive feedback. This will give other user a chance to know not only about game's cons but props too. And it will give us an ability to continue our work on game. Thank you all, our dear Gamers!

Best regards, Double Dice Games! ːwnk_arthurː

[b]This package is intended for the most loyal gamers and will include following elements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Main Soundtrack from game:
- Original Soundtrack from Willy-Nilly Knight game as .wav file (lossless).

[*]Digital Images:
- Main splash-screen: 2048x2048 + 1920x1080

The key art from Willy-Nilly Knight game performed as print-ready electronic book on 34 hand-painted sheets.

[*]Digital World Map:

[*]Digital Stickers:
4 digital ready-to-print stickers with game characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/764f64a93b6c2fda1d79525fef98f331546fba55.png[/img]
We prepare tiny update, that contains a couple of important and very desired features.

[b]Camera rotation from keyboard[/b]
From now you can rotate camera by Home/End keyboard buttons.

[b]Change camera zoom from keyboard[/b]
From now you can change camera zoom by PgUp/PgDn keyboard buttons.

[b]Additional graphic settings[/b]
From now you can select predefined graphic level in the video settings. In additions we add shadows level settings, which can seriously increase the game speed on weak devices.

[b]Trevor's shop fix[/b]
Shields added to the Trevor's shop for old game saves.

Thank you for all your feedbacks, they help us to find and fix bugs as soon as possible! ːwnk_arthurːːwnk_swordːːwnk_shieldː

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/c18ac39151139b1625459f5e7282b1112744d2fe.png[/img]
In this patch we changed a lot of key mechanics of the game.

[b]Changes in battle system:[/b]
Now all your damage have one of the following modificators: piercing, crushing, slashing, ice, fire, electricity, poison, holy and dark. This changes gave us an ability to increase role of the immunes. Furthermore, now damage type can be more efficient on some mobs then the other one.

[b]Weapon requirements:[/b]
From now some skills require exact type of weapon equipped. And of course they change power based on weapon power.

[b]Weapons visualization:[/b]
Equipped weapons now changes not only inventory icon, but 3D model in the character's hands too. This applies to all weapons, except bows, they will be ready in next updates.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/fd3c2d4825c5a1bc778d7b973e7937227dcae2e9.png[/img]

[b]New equipment type - shields:[/b]
Now Arthur can carry shield in the left hand. Shield gave him additional defense. In next updates we will change their mechanic and make it deeper and interesting.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/d4b2d3aa855943468ff357870d29fa2f37fb83d1.png[/img]

[b]Changes in tooltips:[/b]
Information about skills and items now shows in more beauty and readable way. In additions now you can see final attack damage and modifier from skills and items (counted on single base, without enemy defenses and immunes).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/c86499ff32373ccdd6d1d21669214135c665747f.png[/img]

This is the first, but very large and important part of changes in game mechanics and visualization. As ever We will proactively track and correct any bugs that appear. Thank you in advance for your understanding. Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː

notes.title: The release of Willy-Nilly Knight RPG will be held this fall!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/fe379b30c09ddb0ef0618ff937d691171fe18d69.png[/img]
Friends, Double Dice Game Studio is pleased to announce that the developers (wrapped up in warm blankets and in positive mood) are working hard on the game and has almost achieved its ideal quality. Thanks to your support,  our warm and cozy game will be in full-fledged release this fall.

Special thanks goes to those of you, who didn’t fail to spend their time and energy and helped us with the game during its early access, taking part in testing and improving WNK. Only because of the early access period we were able to improve the game to its final quality and to show the world the dream project that we’d planned.

[b]Here's a short list of a small part of the changes that will appear in the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] The new combat system is more convenient, more profound, developed with the help of our players;
[*] The ability to split the game -  better tactical component with the optimal positioning of team members during the battle:
[*] Changing of the weapon models - each sword, bow, staff, ax and hammer will have their own unique image when equipping the character.
[*] Modifiers of damage and immunity - stabbing, crushing, fiery. Now immune to various modifications of the damage has a very important role, for example, attacking skeletons with fire skills is less efficient than doing it with crushing skills.
[*] Partial support for gamepads - the exact degree of support will be clearer to the release date.
[*] More interactive objects in the game (boxes, barrels, chests, etc.) with loot!
[/list]

By far there’s more to it! We are sure you will be pleasantly surprised by the new, high-quality and interesting game of Willy-Nilly Knight!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28195285/e9015b02aef4f5de8e95ac6078d07d590dd7181e.png[/img]
We've prepared a number of nice changes in this update. One of the most important key points is the new crafting system. Many users have complained that the old crafting system wasn't transparent, so players just didn't understand how to use it. We've tried to make the new system easier to understand and use. We've also added notifications about new Journal entries and new locations on the Global Map.

[b]New functionality in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Craft system.
[*]Notifications about new Journal entries.
[*]Notifications about new locations on the Global Map.
[*]Added HP information on selected enemies.
[/list]

[b]Critical fixes in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Skills cannot be used if a character does not have the right weapon equipped.
[*]Fixed bug, when unreachable enemies or interactive items was able to interact instantly from the place.
[/list]

Attention! We've collected a large amount of feedback from you and begun a global rethinking and reworking of certain game mechanics. This applies primarily to the the combat system. Because of this it is possible that you may, on very rare occasions, encounter bugs in the game that cause the game client to crash. We will proactively track and correct any bugs that appear. Thank you in advance for your understanding. Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
Meet the new update. In this patch we collected list of the essential bugfixes, that have prevented you to enjoy the gameplay. Most changes had been made in the field of greater stability and minimize game crushes. In addition we add some new features, making gameplay more comfortable.

[b]New functionality in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new Steam Achievements.
[*]Save the Camera zoom and orientation while loading game or switching scenes.
[*]Added new tooltips to the Action Bar buttons (inventory, skills, craft e.t.c).
[*]Increased the range of characters movements if Camera moved far from the characters.
[/list]

[b]Critical fixes in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug, when unreachable enemies or interactive items was able to interact instantly from the place.
[*]Fixed bugs that crushes the game on rare occasions.
[/list]

Hope you glad to these improvements. In the meantime, we continue to work on the development of the game to make it better and more interesting! Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear friends! We promised you that we will actively monitor your feedback and make timely changes to the game. And we keep our promises! After less than two days after game's release, we are already releasing the first patch with fixed critical errors. This became possible only thanks to your active help, thanks to all who sent their comments on the game.

[b]Critical fixes in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed critical errors, because of which the game could crash or become impassable in some variations of the storylines.
[*]Improved the movement of the camera, now it moves more smoothly. But we will still continue improving it to the ideal state.
[*]The number of available resolutions for monitors has been increased.
[*]Added missing dialogs and avatars for some characters.
[*]Added full screen and windowed modes. 
[*]Fixed enemies' postions in some locations.
[/list]

[b]Minor fixes in the current patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]Next to the empty barrels and chests, the inscription «empty» is now indicated.
[*]The mouse has become more responsive to clicks.
[*]Fixed a description of some healing and enhancing effects of the characters.
[*]Changed the location of the Yes / No buttons in exit menu of the game and other windows with a choice.
[/list]

We continue and will continue working actively on the development of the game. And every new update will make the game better and better! Stay with us and share your opinion, together we «Make the tactical RPG great again!». ːwnk_shieldːːwnk_swordː
